## Overview

`live_rest()` backs an ontology object type with a live REST API, without
copying data locally. When you call `dplyr::collect()`, the filters are
translated to HTTP query parameters and the results are fetched in real time.

## Defining the connection

```{r connection}
library(ontologyConnectR)
library(dplyr)

patient_con <- live_rest(
  schema_map = list(
    Patient = list(
      resource = "patients",
      pk       = "patient_id",
      columns  = list(
        patient_id  = "id",
        family_name = "family_name",
        birth_date  = "birthDate",
        gender      = "gender"
      )
    )
  ),
  base_url   = "https://api.example-hospital.org/v2",
  auth       = conn_auth_bearer(env_var = "HOSPITAL_API_TOKEN"),
  pagination = conn_pagination_link(),
  cache_ttl  = 300L   # cache results for 5 minutes
)
```

## Building the context

```{r context}
library(ontologySpecR)

patient <- object_type(
  "Patient",
  properties = list(
    property_def("patient_id", "string"),
    property_def("family_name", "string"),
    property_def("birth_date", "date"),
    property_def("gender", "string")
  ),
  primary_key = "patient_id"
)

ctx <- connect_context(
  bundle("hospital", "1.0.0", objects = list(patient)),
  live_connections = list(Patient = patient_con)
)
```

## Querying

```{r query}
# Lazy: no network call yet
os <- connect_object_set(ctx, "Patient") |>
  filter(gender == "female") |>
  head(50)

show_query(os)

# One HTTP call per page; pagination is handled automatically
patients <- collect(os)
```

## Pagination

`conn_pagination_link()` follows RFC 5988 `Link: <url>; rel="next"` headers.
For page-number APIs use `conn_pagination_offset()`:

```{r pagination}
conn_pagination_offset(page_param = "page", size_param = "per_page",
                       page_size = 100L)
```

## Authentication

```{r auth}
conn_auth_bearer(env_var = "MY_JWT_TOKEN")
conn_auth_basic(username = "alice", password_env_var = "MY_PASSWORD")
conn_auth_api_key(header = "X-API-Key", key_env_var = "MY_API_KEY")
conn_auth_oauth2(
  token_url             = "https://auth.example.com/oauth/token",
  client_id             = "my-client-id",
  client_secret_env_var = "MY_CLIENT_SECRET",
  scope                 = "read:patients"
)
```

## Caching

```{r caching}
conn_invalidate(patient_con)                 # clear now, e.g. after a write
patient_con <- conn_set_ttl(patient_con, 60L) # change the TTL
```
